dsDescriptionValue.value:
A public database composed of real-world color polarimetric images of the sky in various weather condition over two month (07/08-2022) in La Timone, Marseille, with improved calibration in regard of previous work (https://doi.org/10.57745/610QTS) and manual annotation of weather conditions.

Associated code on github : https://github.com/mol-1/A-2-month-long-annotated-skylight-polarization-images-database---associated-code
